operator_io_quirks: Country has a self-FK Country_Id->Country(Country_Id); process_order must ignore table self-edges or it cycles.
Player.Country_Name is INTEGER FK to Country.Country_Id (name says text, type says int) - column-name-based FK root mapping must follow the FK, not the name.
Match.Outcome_type FK points to Out_Type(Out_Id) but the Outcome table (Outcome_Id,Outcome_Type) is the semantically matching one; FK target is Out_Type, keep as declared.
Match has 10 FKs incl. three to Team (Team_1,Team_2,Toss_Winner,Match_Winner) and one to Player; many-to-one fan-in, parent values reused heavily.
Composite 4-col PKs on Ball_by_Ball, Batsman_Scored, Extra_Runs, Wicket_Taken; Player_Match has 3-col PK. PK members are all INTEGER Number fuzzers.
Ball_by_Ball 136590 and Batsman_Scored 133097 rows: under 300k cap, full read OK, but per-instance size cap 2500 means child tables far smaller than original.
DOB and Match_Date declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'; ts_fuzzer shows 'Date|Number(int elements)' - first element parses as int? No, so Date fuzzer with template %Y-%m-%d.

Player.Bowling_skill null_rate 0.092, Match.Win_Margin 0.016, Match_Winner/Man_of_the_Match 0.005, Wicket_Taken.Fielders 0.276 - nullable FK columns; TS draws from parent values so NULLs only appear if parent empty.
Season.Man_of_the_Series/Orange_Cap/Purple_Cap are INTEGER but semantically Player_Id refs with NO declared FK; TS treats them as plain Number, not FK.
Ball_by_Ball.Striker/Non_Striker/Bowler and Wicket_Taken.Player_Out/Fielders are Player_Id refs with NO declared FK (only Match_Id FK declared); TS will not tie them to Player.
All PKs are INTEGER with no AUTOINCREMENT; TS Number fuzzer range [-10^0,10^0]=[-1,1] for scale 0? scale from type args absent -> default; PK uniqueness filtering will drop most rows.
Table names mixed case (Batting_Style, Ball_by_Ball, Player_Match); must double-quote in generated SQL.
operator_ts_expectations: All INTEGER columns -> Number fuzzer scale 0 (no args): range [-1,1] ints, so PKs collapse to {-1,0,1} and sample_fresh_primary_keys drops nearly all rows -> tiny instances, many empty tables.
DATE columns (DOB, Match_Date) -> Date fuzzer, template %Y-%m-%d from text samples; fresh dates uniform 1800..2100 -> implausible cricket dates (FN source for date-range predicates).
TEXT columns (names, styles, venues) -> String fuzzer over a-zA-Z0-9() with contaminate -> random garbage names; literal pool from train SQL adds real values but p=0.2 fresh dominates.
FK columns draw from parent's FINAL filtered values; with tiny parent PK sets (Team 13, Country 12) child FKs get few distinct values -> ties/duplicates likely, may help or hurt join cardinality.
Season_Year INTEGER -> Number scale 0 -> values in {-1,0,1} instead of 2008..2015; year predicates (Season_Year=2008) return empty -> FN.
Win_Margin, Runs_Scored, Extra_Runs INTEGER -> Number scale 0 -> {-1,0,1}; range predicates (Runs_Scored>4) mostly empty -> FN.
Composite PK tables: PK members each Number scale 0 -> only 3^4=81 possible tuples, PK dedup keeps few rows; child tables (Ball_by_Ball) become near-empty.
Self-FK Country: fill_foreign_keys_consistently draws Country_Id from its own final values -> self-consistent but no new countries.
Player.Country_Name INTEGER FK to Country -> draws from Country.Country_Id final values (1..12) -> plausible; but Player.Batting_hand/Bowling_skill FK to tiny style tables -> few distinct.
Match.Outcome_type FK to Out_Type(Out_Id) (9 rows) not Outcome (3 rows) -> outcome predicates join wrong table, TS inherits schema's odd FK.
String fuzzer length range from samples: e.g. Team_Name len 20-30 -> random strings of that length, not team names -> name-equality predicates FN.
Number list-range quirk (list_max overwritten to full max) means even with literal pool, fresh draws span [-1,1] not the observed range -> implausible magnitudes.
